record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Sobolev and BV norm control by liminf nonlocal tails
record.original_question: With Omega and Phi_{lambda,p} as above, for 1 < p < infinity does there exist a constant C=C(p,N,Omega) such that every measurable u satisfies ||grad u||_{L^p}^p <= C liminf_{lambda->infinity} lambda Phi_{lambda,p}(u), interpreting the left side as infinity when u is not in W^{1,p}(Omega)? Similarly, for p=1, does there exist C=C(N,Omega) such that the total variation mass ||grad u||_M is bounded by C liminf_{lambda->infinity} lambda Phi_{lambda,1}(u), with infinity assigned outside BV(Omega)?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.2 ([32, Section 7.2]). Given any 1 < p < infinity, is there a constant C such that, for all measurable functions u, inequality (9.1) holds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a smooth bounded domain. For a measurable function $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, $\lambda>0$, and $1\le p<\infty$, define the nonlocal functional
$$
\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u) \;=\; \int\!\!\!\int_{\{(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega:\ |u(x)-u(y)|>\lambda |x-y|^{1+N/p}\}} \frac{dx\,dy}{|x-y|^N}.
$$
(Equivalently, $\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u)$ is the weighted measure, with weight $|x-y|^{-N}$, of the set of pairs $(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega$ such that $|u(x)-u(y)|/|x-y|^{1+N/p}>\lambda$.)

Question 1. Let $1<p<\infty$. Does there exist a constant $C=C(p,N,\Omega)$ such that, for every measurable $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$,
$$
\|\nabla u\|_{L^p(\Omega)}^p \;\le\; C\,\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty} \lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u),
$$
with the convention that $\|\nabla u\|_{L^p(\Omega)}^p=+\infty$ whenever $u\notin W^{1,p}(\Omega)$?

Question 2. For $p=1$, does there exist a constant $C=C(N,\Omega)$ such that, for every measurable $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$,
$$
\|\nabla u\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)} \;\le\; C\,\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty} \lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,1}(u),
$$
where $\|\nabla u\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)}$ denotes the total variation of $u$ on $\Omega$, with the convention that this quantity is $+\infty$ when $u\notin BV(\Omega)$?

artifact.status_search_result: A 2025 survey by Hoai-Minh Nguyen on characterizations of Sobolev norms and total variation via nonlocal functionals discusses inequalities of this Brezis–Nguyen type and lists related questions among the open problems in the area. No proof of the stated lower bound for general measurable $u$ in either the $1<p<\infty$ Sobolev case or the $p=1$ BV case appears to be available in the literature.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing characterizations of Sobolev norms and total variation via non-local functionals, and listing related open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent survey still treats Brezis–Nguyen type liminf characterizations as open problems.

status_evidence.title: BV Functions and Nonlocal Functionals in Metric Measure Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies BV characterizations via nonlocal functionals of Brezis–Nguyen type.
status_evidence.claim: Active research direction; the precise liminf lower bound by full Sobolev/BV norm not established in this generality.
